newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Ocean County, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Ocean County, N.J.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Township Chief Financial Officer of the Township of Manchester, in the County of Ocean, New Jersey (the Issuer'') in the Main Meeting Room of the Municipal Building, One Colonial Drive, Manchester, New Jersey 08733 on

until 11:00 a.m., prevailing local time, at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the following $9,357,000 aggregate principal amount of General Improvement Bonds, Series 1996 (the Bonds'') of the Issuer due on December 1 as follows:

The Bonds will be dated December 1, 1996 and will bear interest from said date at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor in accordance with the full Notice of Sale, payable semiannually on June 1 and December 1 in each year until maturity, commencing June 1, 1997 and are subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds will be issued in fully registered book-entry-only form with one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year, registered in the name of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York
(DTC''), as securities depository for the Bonds. Unless

paid from other sources, the Bonds are payable from ad valorem taxes levied upon all taxable property within the Issuer for the payment of the principal of and interest on the Bonds, without limitation as to rate or amount. Upon request of the purchaser, the Bonds will be designated Qualified Tax-Exempt Obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving opinion of the law firm of McLaughlin, Bennett, Gelson & Cramer, Wall Township, New Jersey, Bond Counsel.

The scheduled payment of principal of and interest on the Bonds when due will be guaranteed under an insurance policy, the premium of which is to paid by the Issuer, to be issued concurrently with the delivery of the Bonds by Financial Guaranty Insurance Company.
The Bonds maturing on or before December 1, 2006 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds maturing

on or after December 1, 2007 are subject to redemption to maturity, at the option of the Township, in whole or in part on any date on or after December 1, 2008 upon notice of redemption as hereinafter set forth, and if redeemed in any period shown in the following table, at the redemption price expressed as a percentage of the principal amount thereof, set opposite such period in the following table, together with interest accrued thereon to the redemption date:

Notice of redemption shall be given by publication at least once not more than ninety (90) days nor less than thirty (30) days prior to the date of redemption in a financial newspaper carrying municipal bond news and

published in the City of New York, New York. In addition, notice of redemption shall also be given by first-class mail, postage prepaid, to the registered owners of the bonds or portions thereof to be redeemed, not more than ninety (90) days nor less than thirty (30) days prior to the date of redemption, but such mailing shall not be a condition precedent to such redemption and failure so to mail any such notice shall not affect the validity of any proceedings for the redemption of Bonds.
Copies of the Proposal for Bonds, the full Notice of Sale, the preliminary Official Statement and additional
information on the Bond Sale may be obtained from the undersigned by calling (908) 657-7016. By order of the Mayor and Township Council of the Township of Manchester, in the County of Ocean, N.J.
Township of Manchester, in the County of Ocean
